items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: But mainly there was all the mini-movies with directors like Ridley Scott, Hugh Hudson, Alan Parker, John Frankenheimer, and then great photographers like Elliot Erwitt and David Bailey and Terrence Donovan.

ctx.x: Ah, you’re anticipating a question I’m going to ask later about music and emotions and all that, but I wanted to talk briefly about — do you call them jingles?

Yeah they can be. I don’t feel that I was particularly a jingle composer, although I have written a couple that have been successful on that front. But mainly there was all the mini-movies with directors like Ridley Scott, Hugh Hudson, Alan Parker, John Frankenheimer, and then great photographers like Elliot Erwitt and David Bailey and Terrence Donovan. And my lyricist on a few was Salmon Rushdie.
Oh my God. Well I’m talking about selling products.
